subtasks.title: Add run_branch, run_fanout, and dry_run mode to Pipeline
subtasks.rationale: All three features (run_branch, run_fanout, dry_run) modify only pipeline.py. They share the Pipeline class and can be unit-tested together via the existing test harness. Keeping them in one subtask avoids unnecessary file contention and allows independent verification.

subtasks.title: Add BranchRouterStage and comprehensive branching/fanout/dry_run tests
subtasks.rationale: BranchRouterStage goes into transform.py alongside existing stages. The new test_branching.py covers all 4 scenarios (branch, fanout, dry_run, mixed) and depends on sub-1's Pipeline features. Bundling the stage class with its tests avoids a third subtask, and the stage can be verified independently with test_transform.py.

overall_rationale: 2 subtasks is the minimal split: (1) pipeline.py owns all core logic — 3 features in 1 file, independently verifiable; (2) transform.py adds BranchRouterStage + comprehensive integration tests. A single subtask would work but prevents incremental verification of pipeline logic before adding tests; 3+ subtasks would over-split the 2-file production change (violating '改动面优先 1 个任务' principle).
